description: Extension of OnboardingView providing various asynchronous and monitoring-related functions such as permission refresh, permission requests, monitoring updates, CLI installation, and local gateway probing.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A view component extended to include monitoring and permission management functionalities.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the permission state by calling 'refreshNow' on 'permissionMonitor'.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, ensuring only one request at a time, then refreshes permissions.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Updates monitoring status for permissions based on the current page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Updates discovery monitoring based on the current page index, starting or stopping discovery tasks accordingly.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Calls both permission and discovery monitoring update functions based on page index, and may initiate onboarding chat.

methods.name: stopDiscovery
methods.description: Stops device discovery monitoring if active.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Asynchronously installs CLI tools, updating status messages.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Refreshes CLI installation status including location and whether installed.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the local gateway, updating the probe state with command info and whether it meets expected criteria.
